summary: OddOneGaming showcases a full-auto clear team capable of handling Meander Trial stages 1 through 60 in Season 9 without getting stuck. The core composition relies heavily on Radiance/Aura synergy featuring Talethia, Child of Chaos, and Anneliesis, supported by Diantha and Holfast. For players missing certain pieces, replacements such as Lincos, Solmo, Ardreth, Gillian, or Ripekas are recommended to add survival and crowd control. Crucial gear choices include equipping accuracy on Anneliesis to land stuns and positioning Whirlwind Edge wearers next to Talethia.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Described as the number one hero everyone should get, serving as the primary damage engine; does not strictly need Inspiration 5 to clear.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.verdict: Core Radiance support and crowd controller
heroes.note: Provides excellent crowd control and team buffs; needs sufficient Accuracy to ensure her ultimate consistently lands stuns.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Acts as the frontline anchor and healer using Moonlight's Grace and Monelisse's Teardrop to prevent one-shots.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Channels Aura energy to allies and provides offensive support; can be substituted with Lincos if unavailable.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.verdict: Great Radiance damage dealer and buffer
heroes.note: Supplies an Attack Aura and Aura energy, boosting team damage through artifacts like Orb of the Dragon God and gear sets like Whirling Edge.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Recommended direct replacement if you lack Holfast.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.verdict: Top control and utility tank option
heroes.note: Brings multiple debuffs, ultimate energy pushback, and stuns if your team struggles with enemy damage and survival.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Can be slotted in for additional shields and survival if the team is dying.

heroes.name: Ardreth
heroes.note: Provides a defense aura and support utility to help keep the team alive against heavy hits.

heroes.name: Gillian
heroes.note: An accessible Radiance option if more consistent healing is required to survive stages.

teams.note: Full auto team for stages 1 to 60. Child of Chaos tanks in front, Diantha sits within 1 tile of Talethia to grant Whirling Edge buffs, and Anneliesis provides stun CC.

tips: Equip the hero positioned right next to Talethia with the Whirling Edge set to permanently stack bonus damage onto her.
Ensure Anneliesis is built with enough Accuracy so her ultimate ability reliably stuns enemy targets.
Equip Monelisse's Teardrop on Child of Chaos to prevent unexpected one-shots on the frontline.
Use Glimmering Long-Eared Deer (or Golden Tressym) as your familiar for control, shields, and survivability.
If failing due to lack of survival, swap a secondary damage dealer for crowd control (stun/knock-up) or healing heroes like Solmo, Gillian, or Ripekas.
title: 🚨 EASY Full Auto Clear 🚨 1 Team ALL Of Meander Trial Stage 1-60 S9 | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
